scope: ROMA SEAL-0; primary H/R1/R2 only; common complete ratings in both arms and dimensions
aggregation: Within-question means over common valid matched rounds, then equal question means; V2 minus BASE
composite_definition: Arithmetic mean of Planning and Communication within each question-round-arm; author-derived, not a native MARBLE score

uncertainty.method: Paired question percentile bootstrap; all rounds stay together; same sampled question indices for three measures
uncertainty.conditions_on: Observed valid scores and rated question sample, not repeated judge evaluations
